NFL DFS Wide Receiver Rankings: Week 11 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 22 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 21, 10:25 AM ET

CeeDee Lamb is the top-projected wide receiver on the Week 11 DraftKings main slate at 21.3 DraftKings points for $8,800, against Tennessee. Amon-Ra St. Brown (18.7, $8,200) and George Pickens (16.5, $6,800) are next.

Tre' Harris returns the most per dollar among wide receivers projected for at least 9 points: 2.77 projected points per $1,000 at $4,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 21, 10:25 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Wide receivers to know in Week 11

CeeDee Lamb, DAL vs TEN ($8,800)

CeeDee Lamb carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 21.3 DraftKings points at $8,800. That is 2.6 points clear of Amon-Ra St. Brown. The model gives him 10.0 targets on 32.0 routes. The salary works out to 2.42 projected points per $1,000, 6th of 29 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Lamb averaged 21.3 points with a simulated floor of 7.8 and a ceiling of 46.7, and he holds 28% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Dallas is a 7.5-point favorite at home against Tennessee, with an implied team total of 31 in a game totaled at 54.5.

Amon-Ra St. Brown, DET vs TB ($8,200)

Amon-Ra St. Brown projects 2nd at the position with 18.7 DraftKings points at $8,200. The model gives him 8.8 targets on 28.1 routes. The salary works out to 2.28 projected points per $1,000, 7th of 29 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Brown averaged 18.7 points with a simulated floor of 5.7 and a ceiling of 43.7, and he holds 19% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 5.5-point favorite at home against Tampa Bay, with an implied team total of 25.5 in a game totaled at 45.5.

George Pickens, DAL vs TEN ($6,800)

George Pickens projects 3rd at the position with 16.5 DraftKings points at $6,800. The model gives him 7.5 targets on 33.3 routes. The salary works out to 2.43 projected points per $1,000, 4th of 29 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Pickens averaged 16.7 points with a simulated floor of 3.8 and a ceiling of 41.6, and he holds 19% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Dallas is a 7.5-point favorite at home against Tennessee, with an implied team total of 31 in a game totaled at 54.5.

Value: Tre' Harris, LAC vs NYJ ($4,000)

Tre' Harris projects for 11.1 DraftKings points at $4,000, which works out to 2.77 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 29 wide receivers the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 4.9 targets on 21.6 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Harris averaged 11.1 points with a simulated floor of 3.1 and a ceiling of 24.9, and he holds 15% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Chargers are a 3-point favorite at home against the Jets, with an implied team total of 22.75 in a game totaled at 42.5.
